author: Inside Edition
description: Former teen heartthrob Donny Osmond had just attended church and was celebrating his granddaughter's birthday at a backyard party when thick smoke began to rise from a  neighboring property. The 68-year-old entertainer knew just what to do after an outdoor grill went up in flames. Springing into action, the pop star saved the day while wearing his Sunday best. Later, the "Puppy Love" singer joked that he had a new gig: fireman.
title: Former Teen Heartthrob Donny Osmond Fights Fire In Church Clothes

author: Inside Edition
description: If you are bringing food to your family’s Thanksgiving meal, Inside Edition has some do’s and don'ts to help make things delicious and safe to eat. First tip: don’t microwave the stuffing because it can make the dish squishy. And if your mashed potatoes look dry, chef Amanda Weiss says you can add a splash of milk or chicken stock to bring them back to freshness. Lifestyle expert Marisa Brahney gave Steven Fabian and his wife, Thea, tips on traveling with food.
title: Do’s and Don’ts For Traveling With Thanksgiving Food

author: Inside Edition
description: Millions of Americans have already headed out early for Thanksgiving vacation, and a record number will be traveling this Wednesday. But travel for this year's holiday is being affected by a so-called "triple whammy" – a confluence of woes over technology, weather and security that is making many people jittery. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian explains why some may not be so thankful for Thanksgiving this year.
title: Thanksgiving Travel Being Hit By A 'Triple Whammy'

author: Inside Edition
description:
A man in Arizona was driving down an interstate when witnesses say a 7-foot-long wooden plank flew off a white pickup truck and torpedoed into the man’s windshield, slamming into his face. DJ Hughes, a mechanic and dad, was rushed to the hospital with fractures to every bone in his face. Inside Edition’s Jim Moret spoke to his mom from the hospital. So far Hughes has had three surgeries, and will have his fourth surgery on Wednesday.

A GoFundMe was set up by Hughes' family to help him during his recovery. For more information, click on this link: https://ietv.co/4jxKtXc
title: Man Survives Wooden Plank Slamming Into His Car Windshield

author: Inside Edition
description: Miley Cyrus tied the knot over the weekend in an intimate ceremony. While the details were kept under wraps, pictures and videos of the wedding have been revealed. Cyrus wiped tears from her eyes as her groom, drummer Maxx Morando, read his vows. After saying “I do,” Cyrus posted a series of black and white photos. The pop sensation wore a Saint Laurent gown. The wedding was held at the Palm Springs former home of legendary entertainer Frank Sinatra.
title: Miley Cyrus Ties The Knot With Drummer Maxx Morando

author: Inside Edition
description: An elderly man took a tumble right onto train tracks while he was crossing the street. Police in Boca Raton, Florida, say his walker got caught on the tracks, which tripped him up. An officer saw the man struggling and got out of his cruiser to help get him out of harm's way. Once the man was out of the path of any oncoming trains, a bystander helped by getting his walker off the tracks and giving it back to him. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Officer Saves Elderly Man Who Fell On Train Tracks And Couldn't Get Up

author: Inside Edition
description: Animal Control Officer Sophia Landrey assisted Manchester Fire Department officials in rescuing a feisty kitten from the back of a highway sign over I-293 in New Hampshire. After shutting the highway down, she and the fire department worked to reach the kitten using a bucket and a ladder. The cat was mad at first and tried to bite as she was getting rescued. Now she’s healing from her injuries and hoping for a new home. Inside Edition Digital’s Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Feisty Kitten Rescued From Highway Sign

author: Inside Edition
description:
NVIDIA has announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as CEO of the AI technology company. This comes after Huang admitted to having an affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang. After the affair was revealed, allegations emerged that she may have been connected to a Chinese intelligence operation targeting him. NVIDIA said in a statement, 
"The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA." Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Jensen Huang Reinstated As CEO Of NVIDIA

author: Inside Edition
description: A parked patrol car was hit by a passing vehicle on a highway in Gaines County, Texas Thursday, luckily the police officer who was standing with a civilian were not struck. The vehicle who struck the patrol car kept on driving as if nothing happened. But that wasn’t the only close call caught by a county sheriff’s dash cam. Over in Florida on the same day, a Sarasota County Sheriff’s Office deputy narrowly avoided being struck by an SUV during a traffic stop.
title: Two Close Calls As Cars Crash into Police Cruisers Caught on Camera

author: Inside Edition
description: Chocolatier Milton Hershey was a complicated figure, but he's still revered in the central Pennsylvania town that bears his name.
title: The Real Story Behind 'Hershey' #shorts
